hypothesis: Common entry acquires all seven secondary cores with exactly the specified register writes and refuses every unsafe inherited state.

conditions.code: platform/a733/probe.c, linked into the audio and memory-test probe images

narrative: Linked instruction checks model delayed PWSR acknowledgment, stale PWPR, in-flight wake, changing requests, invalid last-core identity, deadlines and a stopped counter. They check all seven cores, the exact register write scope (policy words 0x07053000..0x07059000, hotplug control 0x07050204..0x0705021c; no write to CPU0 0x07052000, cluster page 0x07051000, a power domain, a rail, a clock or a reset), preservation of the hotplug upper fields and every original held-state predicate. CPU-origin cases keep their first sampled inputs. Memtest checks verify protected placement, relocation closure, stack bounds and beacons. Three independent reviewers inspected design and code; linked memory-test and audio images received separate inspections. The full integration gate and the check index cover software integration. Vendor sequence: BL31 clears the low policy nibble of nine CPUIDLE words at binary offset 0x4e88 (dynamic-enable bit 8 preserved); Arm DEN0051E sections 3.4.3 and 4.1.1 give the completion condition.

hypothesis: Common entry normalizes inherited secondary-core policies on the board and the board returns repeatedly without a replug.
prediction: Physical proof needs audio control, a scan-only memory probe and audio control on port 3-1 without a replug. Each run passes common entry and retains the inherited policies it normalizes. Acquisition latency on hardware is unmeasured; the 100 ms deadline and 65,536-sample limit bound availability only. Camera reset and gate normalization remain with the camera owner.
conclusion: Not yet run. Physical transitions and repeatability are unqualified.
narrative: Planned sequence on port 3-1: audio control, scan-only memory probe, audio control, no replug between them.
